135:t_2:18.en:
$$スザク$$
「It's the same for the people here in $$新日本$$ who are helping the $$黒の騎士団$$.」

135:t_2:19.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「They don't have a $$ユニコーン$$ or a $$ジェニオン$$. But each of them has a reason to fight, and they cooperate with us with firm resolve.」

135:t_2:20.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All I can do is fight alongside them and bring peace back as soon as possible.」

135:t_2:21.en:
$$スザク$$
「Did that convince you, $$バナージ$$?」

135:t_2:22.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...After 《$$新世時空震動$$》, I read a fair amount of material on the $$ＡＤＷ$$, but...」

135:t_2:23.en:
$$バナージ$$
「So you're a little different from the $$ゼロ$$ the public knows.」

135:t_2:24.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I admit that, as those accounts say, I deliberately behaved in a dramatic fashion...」

135:t_2:25.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「But at least now, I don't do anything unnecessary. I simply seek victory.」

135:t_2:27.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Sort of. I'm grateful to everyone in 《$$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$》.」

135:t_2:28.en:
$$スザク$$
「$$ゼロ$$ and I are just like you.」

135:t_2:29.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Sorry, Mr. $$ゼロ$$... I seem to have misjudged you based on nothing but an impression.」

135:t_2:30.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「No need for a title. As long as I wear this mask, I'm not an individual, just a symbol called $$ゼロ$$.」

135:t_2:31.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「And that symbol gathers people's wishes and leads them to victory.」

135:t_2:32.en:
$$バナージ$$
「A vessel... is that what you mean?」

135:t_2:33.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I take pride in being different from $$フル・フロンタル$$.」

135:t_2:35.en:
$$バナージ$$
「During the $$時獄戦役$$ there was some distance between us, but talking like this, I feel close to you.」

135:t_2:36.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It may be the result of your sensitivity growing sharper.」

135:t_2:37.en:
$n
「You mean he's a $$ニュータイプ$$...?」

135:t_2:38.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...Captain $$アムロ$$ told me that too. That by drawing out the $$ユニコーン$$'s power, the $$ユニコーン$$ in turn expands my consciousness...」

135:t_2:39.en:
$$スザク$$
「Sounds like $$刹那$$'s $$ダブルオーライザー$$.」

135:t_2:40.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「GN Particles, the $$ゼロシステム$$, the $$サイコ・フレーム$$... Machines that make people evolve...」

135:t_2:41.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It's just like our ancestors, who created civilization when they got hold of fire...」

135:t_2:44.en:
$n
「Blood of the beast, mingling of waters, destination of the wind, civilization of fire... And the radiance of the sun...」

135:t_2:45.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Words I heard several times during the $$時獄戦役$$...」

135:t_2:46.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$バナージ$$... You were uncomfortable with civilians fighting, but...」

135:t_2:47.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Perhaps in the situation we're in now, it doesn't matter whether you're a soldier or a civilian...」

135:t_2:49.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...War is fought between soldiers. But in the struggle for survival, everyone alive is a party to it.」

135:t_2:51.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...Forget it. I just said something I vaguely sensed, without thinking.」

135:t_2:52.en:
$n
($$ゼロ$$ too... Does he feel the same kind of unease that Miss $$スズネ$$ and I do...?)

135:t_2:55.en:
$$玉城$$
「Word just came in! A big Empire force is closing in on the Kansai area!」

135:t_2:57.en:
$$スザク$$
「Was $$ギルター$$ just a diversion!?」

135:t_2:58.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Going by the way that man talked, no.」

135:t_2:60.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「There's only one possibility... Someone with greater authority than $$ギルター$$ used him as a decoy.」

135:t_2:62.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$玉城$$! Issue an emergency call-up to every member of $c! We're heading to Kansai as well!」

135:t_2:65.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It's all right. I've stationed them at $$厳島$$.」

135:t_2:66.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「If it's them, they'll surely come through... Let's trust in that for now.」

135:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...It seems everyone is busy intercepting the $$サイデリアル$$.」

135:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I too shall cooperate, in my capacity as a dimensional merchant... I'll provide the $$サーペント$$ I had stocked up free of charge.」

135:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$Ｄトレーダー$$ is open for business without a break again today! Now then, let's give it our all... business, business!」

135:t_10:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...What do you make of it?」

135:t_10:8.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「You're right, of course. When I sharpen my senses, I can feel such things.」

135:t_10:12.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I want a little more time to organize my thoughts.」

135:t_10:13.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「You're unusually vague. But all I can do here is leave it to you.」

135:t_10:14.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「The dimensional merchant $$ＡＧ$$... If he holds the answer to the questions inside you...」

135:t_10:15.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Pinning down his true identity will carry great significance for the future of the world...」

136:t_000:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, you're in position, I take it.」

136:t_000:1.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「I get that we're lulling the enemy into letting their guard down, but isn't our force way too small, no matter how you look at it...?」

136:t_000:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I just figured you could handle it.」

136:t_000:3.en:
$$デュオ$$
「I'm not green enough to fall for flattery like that.」

136:t_000:4.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「$$扇$$ or $$玉城$$ might have fallen for it hook, line and sinker, though.」

136:t_000:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Good work, $$玉城$$. How did it go?」

136:t_000:7.en:
$$玉城$$
「Heh heh... It's all set. Trust the skills of the $$新日本$$ Volunteer Army's Covert Ops leader.」

136:t_000:8.en:
$$カトル$$
「You're really full of life, $$玉城$$.」

136:t_000:9.en:
$$トロワ$$
「That kind of work seems to suit him better than being a cafe owner.」

136:t_000:10.en:
$$玉城$$
「It's not that, but when that $$ゼロ$$ stands up, I can't just keep quiet, being his super best friend and all.」

136:t_000:11.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「Ranked up from best friend, even...」

136:t_000:12.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Still, the reason $$新日本$$ can keep fighting like this is mostly thanks to the volunteer army.」

136:t_000:13.en:
$$トロワ$$
「And what rallies their hearts is the existence of $$ゼロ$$ and the $$黒の騎士団$$.」

136:t_000:14.en:
$$カトル$$
「The people of this country remember, don't they. The days they fought alongside $$ゼロ$$ and won victories.」

136:t_000:15.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「At the same time, they know. The pain of having things taken from them.」

136:t_000:16.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「So they fight to the end. With pride, too.」
